question: What is the number of protons present in beryllium.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Beryllium is a chemical element with the **symbol Be **and **atomic number 4.**
 
• The atomic number represents the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom. Therefore, **every atom of beryllium contains 4 protons.**
 
• The number of protons determines the identity of the element. **Any atom with 4 protons is always beryllium.**
